text_block_list.text:
To take on the world, "DREAMS" has pushed 
through relentless effort alongside their 
teammates.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We will conquer the Breeders' Cup, without 
fail. United by this sentiment, the team's 
passion had reached its absolute peak!
